# Branch Naming and Collaboration Policy

- `main`: release-ready
- `development`: integration
- `feature/<short-description>`: feature work
- `fix/<short-description>`: normal fixes
- `hotfix/<short-description>`: urgent fixes

Rules:
1. No direct commits to `main`.
2. Feature branches start from `development`.
3. Open a pull request before merging.
4. Keep commits small and meaningful.
5. Delete merged feature branches.

Commit format: `<type>: <short description>`.
